import * as component_1 from '@kne/current-lib_react-form';
import * as component_2 from 'antd';
const readmeConfig = {
    name: "react-form",
    summary: "<h4>核心特性</h4>\n<h5>📦 轻量级状态管理</h5>\n<ul>\n<li>基于 React Context + State，零额外依赖</li>\n<li>支持嵌套分组和复杂数据结构</li>\n<li>实时状态更新，O(1) 高效数据访问</li>\n</ul>\n<h5>🎛️ 灵活字段控制</h5>\n<ul>\n<li><code>useField</code> Hook，字段级精细化控制</li>\n<li>支持字段级拦截器与关联联动</li>\n<li>内置防抖，智能去空值处理</li>\n</ul>\n<h5>📡 事件驱动架构</h5>\n<ul>\n<li>基于事件发射器的解耦设计</li>\n<li>支持表单/字段/分组三级事件监听</li>\n<li>便于扩展和自定义</li>\n</ul>\n<h5>✅ 强大验证系统</h5>\n<ul>\n<li>内置规则：必填、手机号、邮箱、长度等</li>\n<li>支持异步远程验证</li>\n<li>可自定义规则与错误提示</li>\n</ul>\n<h5>📁 分组管理</h5>\n<ul>\n<li>支持无限嵌套分组结构</li>\n<li>GroupList 动态增删，轻松管理</li>\n<li>支持分组级数据批量操作</li>\n</ul>\n<h5>🎮 表单 API</h5>\n<ul>\n<li><code>useFormApi</code> Hook，完整操作能力</li>\n<li>支持获取/设置表单数据</li>\n<li>支持字段级验证控制</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>设计理念</h4>\n<p>Form 组件采用分层架构设计，将表单管理、状态管理、事件处理、验证逻辑等职责分离，通过 Context 进行数据传递，实现了高度解耦和可扩展性。</p>\n<h4>核心架构</h4>\n<h5>Context 层</h5>\n<p>Form 通过 Provider 将表单的核心能力传递给子组件，包括：</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>emitter</code> - 事件发射器，负责表单内部的事件通信</li>\n<li><code>openApi</code> - 表单操作接口，提供数据获取、设置、验证等方法</li>\n<li><code>task</code> - 任务管理器，处理异步任务队列</li>\n<li><code>formState</code> - 表单状态，使用 Map 存储所有字段的状态</li>\n<li><code>setFormState</code> - 表单状态更新函数</li>\n<li><code>formIsMount</code> - 表单挂载状态</li>\n<li><code>rules</code> - 验证规则集合，包含内置规则和自定义规则</li>\n<li><code>interceptor</code> - 拦截器配置</li>\n<li><code>onSubmit</code> / <code>onError</code> / <code>onFormDataChange</code> - 提交、错误与数据变化回调</li>\n</ul>\n<h5>Provider 层次结构</h5>\n<pre><code>Form (根组件)\n  ├─ Provider (Context 传递)\n  │   ├─ FormApiProvider (封装 openApi)\n  │   │   └─ FormEvent (事件监听和处理)\n  │   │       └─ children (表单字段)\n</code></pre>\n<h4>字段系统</h4>\n<h5>useField Hook</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">const fieldProps = useField({\n  name: 'fieldName',      // 字段名称（必填）\n  label: '字段标签',       // 字段标签\n  rule: 'REQ LEN-3-10', // 验证规则\n  interceptor: 'trim',      // 拦截器\n  associations: { ... }     // 字段关联\n});\n</code></pre>\n<h5>字段状态</h5>\n<p>每个字段都有独立的状态对象，包含：</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>id</code> - 字段唯一标识</li>\n<li><code>name</code> - 字段名称</li>\n<li><code>groupName</code> - 所属分组名称</li>\n<li><code>groupIndex</code> - 分组索引</li>\n<li><code>value</code> - 字段值</li>\n<li><code>label</code> - 字段标签</li>\n<li><code>rule</code> - 验证规则</li>\n<li><code>validate</code> - 验证状态（INIT/PENDING/PASS/ERROR）</li>\n<li><code>errMsg</code> - 错误信息</li>\n</ul>\n<h5>表单状态</h5>\n<p>使用 Map 结构存储所有字段状态，通过 <code>formStateRef.current</code> 持有引用，确保状态更新的一致性。</p>\n<h4>验证规则</h4>\n<h5>规则格式</h5>\n<p>验证规则支持三种格式：</p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>字符串格式</strong>：<code>\"REQ LEN-3-10 EMAIL\"</code> - 空格分隔多个规则</li>\n<li><strong>函数格式</strong>：自定义验证函数</li>\n<li><strong>正则表达式</strong>：直接使用正则验证</li>\n</ol>\n<h5>规则解析</h5>\n<pre><code>规则格式：{RULE_NAME}-{arg1}-{arg2}-{arg3}...\n\n示例：\n- \"REQ\"              → 规则名：REQ，无参数\n- \"LEN-3-10\"         → 规则名：LEN，参数：min=3, max=10\n- \"REQ LEN-3-10\"     → 多个规则组合\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>解析步骤</strong>：</p>\n<ol>\n<li>按空格分割规则字符串 → <code>[\"REQ\", \"LEN-3-10\"]</code></li>\n<li>对每个规则按 <code>-</code> 分割 → <code>[\"LEN\", \"3\", \"10\"]</code></li>\n<li>第一部分为规则名（转为大写匹配） → <code>LEN</code></li>\n<li>后续部分为规则参数 → <code>[3, 10]</code></li>\n</ol>\n<h5>内置规则</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>规则名</th>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n<th>验证逻辑</th>\n<th>错误提示</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>REQ</code></td>\n<td>无</td>\n<td>必填验证</td>\n<td>值非空（null/undefined/''）</td>\n<td>-</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>TEL</code></td>\n<td>无</td>\n<td>手机号验证</td>\n<td>匹配 <code>/^1[0-9]{10}$/</code></td>\n<td>\"请输入有效的手机号\"</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>EMAIL</code></td>\n<td>无</td>\n<td>邮箱验证</td>\n<td>匹配邮箱正则</td>\n<td>\"请输入有效的邮箱\"</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>LEN</code></td>\n<td>min, max</td>\n<td>长度验证</td>\n<td>min ≤ 长度 ≤ max</td>\n<td>\"%s长度必须大于min/小于max/等于min\"</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h5>自定义规则</h5>\n<p>规则函数接收参数：<code>(value, ...args, { data, field })</code></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">// 同步验证规则\nrules: {\n  PASSWORD_STRENGTH: (value, level, { data }) =&gt; {\n    const strength = checkStrength(value);\n    return {\n      result: strength &gt;= level,\n      errMsg: strength &gt;= level ? '' : '密码强度不足',\n      data: { strength }\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n// 异步验证规则\nrules: {\n  CHECK_UNIQUE: async (value, { field }) =&gt; {\n    const exists = await api.checkUnique(field.name, value);\n    return {\n      result: !exists,\n      errMsg: exists ? '该值已存在' : ''\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n// 使用数据联动\nrules: {\n  MATCH_PASSWORD: (value, { data }) =&gt; {\n    return {\n      result: value === data.password,\n      errMsg: '两次输入的密码不一致'\n    };\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h5>验证流程</h5>\n<p><strong>单个字段验证流程</strong>：</p>\n<pre><code>1. 触发验证\n   ├─ 用户输入 (onChange + 防抖)\n   ├─ 失焦事件 (onBlur)\n   ├─ 手动调用 validateField()\n   └─ 表单提交 (validateAll())\n   ↓\n2. 查找字段\n   ├─ 通过 id 查找\n   ├─ 通过 name 查找\n   ├─ 通过 groupName + groupIndex + name 查找\n   └─ 未找到则跳过\n   ↓\n3. 解析验证规则\n   ├─ 分割规则字符串 (空格分隔)\n   ├─ 匹配内置规则 (REQ, TEL, EMAIL, LEN)\n   └─ 匹配自定义规则\n   ↓\n4. 执行验证\n   ├─ 更新字段状态为 PENDING\n   ├─ 依次执行每个规则\n   ├─ 同步规则立即返回结果\n   └─ 异步规则等待 Promise\n   ↓\n5. 处理验证结果\n   ├─ 全部通过 → 状态设为 PASS\n   ├─ 任意失败 → 状态设为 ERROR，记录错误信息\n   └─ 更新 formState\n   ↓\n6. 触发事件\n   ├─ emit('form-field:validate:{fieldId}')\n   ├─ 触发关联字段的 associations 回调\n   └─ 计算表单整体 isPass 状态\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>表单整体验证流程</strong>：</p>\n<pre><code>1. 触发 validateAll()\n   ↓\n2. 遍历所有字段\n   ├─ 对每个字段执行单字段验证流程\n   └─ 收集验证结果\n   ↓\n3. 判断表单状态\n   ├─ 所有字段都 PASS → isPass = true\n   └─ 存在任意 ERROR 或 PENDING → isPass = false\n   ↓\n4. 返回验证结果\n   └─ 提交处理\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>验证规则执行顺序</strong>：</p>\n<p>规则按照声明顺序依次执行，遇到第一个失败的规则即停止。</p>\n<p>示例：<code>rule=\"REQ LEN-3-20 EMAIL\"</code></p>\n<ol>\n<li>检查必填 (REQ)</li>\n<li>检查长度 (LEN-3-20)</li>\n<li>检查邮箱格式 (EMAIL)</li>\n</ol>\n<p>若第 1 步失败，则不会执行后续检查。</p>\n<h4>字段关联</h4>\n<h5>设计机制</h5>\n<p>字段关联是 react-form 实现表单字段联动的核心机制，通过监听关联字段的变化，自动更新目标字段的值。</p>\n<h5>配置结构</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">{\n  fields: [{ name: 'field1' }, { name: 'field2' }],\n  callback: ({ target, origin, openApi }) =&gt; {\n    // 当关联字段变化时，更新目标字段\n    openApi.setFieldValue(target, computedValue);\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>必填</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>fields</code></td>\n<td><code>Array&lt;FieldReference&gt;</code></td>\n<td>是</td>\n<td>关联字段列表，当这些字段变化时触发回调</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>callback</code></td>\n<td><code>Function</code></td>\n<td>是</td>\n<td>关联回调函数，接收变化信息并更新目标字段</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h5>FieldReference 引用类型</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">// 单字段引用\n{ name: 'fieldName' }\n\n// 分组字段引用\n{ name: 'fieldName', groupName: 'groupName' }\n\n// 分组特定项引用\n{\n  name: 'fieldName',\n  groupName: 'groupName',\n  groupIndex: 0  // 索引从 0 开始\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h5>Callback 回调参数</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">callback: ({ target, origin, openApi, data }) =&gt; {\n  // target: 目标字段的完整对象\n  //   - id: 字段唯一标识\n  //   - name: 字段名称\n  //   - value: 字段当前值\n  //   - groupName: 所属分组（如果有）\n  //   - groupIndex: 分组索引（如果有）\n\n  // origin: 源字段的值（仅在单字段关联时有值）\n\n  // openApi: 表单 API 对象，提供操作方法\n  //   - getFormData(): 获取表单数据\n  //   - setFieldValue(target, value): 设置字段值\n  //   - setFieldValidate(target, validate): 设置验证状态\n\n  // data: 表单完整数据（包含所有字段）\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h5>触发时机</h5>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>关联字段值变化</strong> - 用户输入或程序修改关联字段的值</li>\n<li><strong>关联字段验证完成</strong> - 字段验证通过后触发</li>\n<li><strong>表单数据批量设置</strong> - 通过 <code>setFormData()</code> 或 <code>setFields()</code> 批量更新数据</li>\n</ol>\n<h5>执行顺序</h5>\n<p>关联更新会递归触发，注意避免循环依赖。</p>\n<h5>避免循环关联</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">// ❌ 错误：循环依赖\n&lt;Input name=\"a\" associations={{ fields: [{ name: 'b' }], callback: ({ origin }) =&gt; origin }} /&gt;\n&lt;Input name=\"b\" associations={{ fields: [{ name: 'a' }], callback: ({ origin }) =&gt; origin }} /&gt;\n\n// ✅ 正确：单向依赖\n&lt;Input name=\"fullName\" associations={{\n  fields: [{ name: 'firstName' }, { name: 'lastName' }],\n  callback: ({ data }) =&gt; \\`\\${data.firstName}\\${data.lastName}\\`\n}} /&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<h5>实用场景</h5>\n<p>详见 <code>associations.js</code> 示例文件，包含以下场景：</p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>单字段值复制</strong> - 将一个字段的值自动复制到另一个字段</li>\n<li><strong>多字段值拼接</strong> - 将多个字段的值拼接成一个新值</li>\n<li><strong>数值计算</strong> - 基于多个字段的值进行计算</li>\n<li><strong>分组字段聚合</strong> - 对分组内的多个字段值进行汇总</li>\n</ol>\n<p>条件显示与赋值见 <code>linkage.js</code>：用 <code>useWatch</code> 订阅 <code>form:field:set-value</code> 后条件渲染字段；显示时用 <code>setField</code> 赋值（未挂载会写入 pending），显示后继续用 <code>associations</code> 跟随源字段。</p>\n<h4>拦截器</h4>\n<h5>拦截器类型</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>执行时机</th>\n<th>用途</th>\n<th>方向</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>input</code></td>\n<td>值存入表单前</td>\n<td>数据清理、转换、规范化</td>\n<td>外部 → 内部</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>output</code></td>\n<td>值从表单取出时</td>\n<td>数据格式化、转换</td>\n<td>内部 → 外部</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h5>注册机制</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">// 全局拦截器（所有表单共享）\nimport { interceptors } from 'react-form';\n\n// 注册输入拦截器\ninterceptors.input.use('trim', value =&gt; value.trim());\n\n// 注册输出拦截器\ninterceptors.output.use('formatDate', value =&gt; {\n  return value ? new Date(value).toISOString() : null;\n});\n</code></pre>\n<h5>表单级拦截器（优先级高于全局）</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">&lt;Form\n  interceptors={{\n    input: [\n      {\n        name: 'customTrim',\n        exec: value =&gt; value.trim()\n      }\n    ],\n    output: [\n      {\n        name: 'uppercase',\n        exec: value =&gt; value.toUpperCase()\n      }\n    ]\n  }}\n&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<h5>字段级拦截器配置</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">&lt;Input\n  name=\"email\"\n  rule=\"EMAIL\"\n  interceptor=\"trim\"  // 指定使用的拦截器\n/&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<h5>优先级</h5>\n<pre><code>优先级从高到低：\n1. 字段指定拦截器\n2. 表单级拦截器\n3. 全局拦截器\n\n同名拦截器：后注册的覆盖先注册的\n</code></pre>\n<h5>常用拦截器</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { interceptors } from 'react-form';\n\n// 常用输入拦截器\ninterceptors.input.use('trim', v =&gt; v?.trim?.());\ninterceptors.input.use('toUpperCase', v =&gt; v?.toUpperCase?.());\ninterceptors.input.use('toLowerCase', v =&gt; v?.toLowerCase?.());\ninterceptors.input.use('removeComma', v =&gt; v?.replace?.(/,/g, ''));\n\n// 常用输出拦截器\ninterceptors.output.use('toNumber', v =&gt; v ? parseFloat(v) : null);\ninterceptors.output.use('formatCurrency', v =&gt; v ? \\`¥\\${v.toFixed(2)}\\` : '¥0.00');\ninterceptors.output.use('defaultEmpty', v =&gt; v || '');\n</code></pre>\n<h4>分组管理</h4>\n<h5>GroupList 组件</h5>\n<p>用于管理动态增删的分组字段。</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">&lt;GroupList ref={ref} name=\"groupName\" defaultLength={2}&gt;\n  {({ index, onAdd, onRemove, length }) =&gt; (\n    // 分组项内容\n  )}\n&lt;/GroupList&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<h5>回调参数</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>index</code></td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td>当前项的索引</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>onAdd</code></td>\n<td><code>Function</code></td>\n<td>添加新项的函数</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>onRemove</code></td>\n<td><code>Function</code></td>\n<td>移除当前项的函数</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>length</code></td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td>分组当前项数</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>表单 API</h4>\n<h5>useSubmit Hook</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">const { isLoading, isPass, onClick } = useSubmit();\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>isLoading</code></td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>提交中状态</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>isPass</code></td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>表单是否通过验证</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>onClick</code></td>\n<td><code>Function</code></td>\n<td>提交函数</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h5>useReset Hook</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">const { onClick } = useReset();\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>onClick</code></td>\n<td><code>Function</code></td>\n<td>重置函数</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h5>useFormApi Hook</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">const { openApi } = useFormApi();\n</code></pre>\n<h5>openApi 方法</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>类别</th>\n<th>方法</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>数据操作</strong></td>\n<td><code>data</code> / <code>setData()</code></td>\n<td>获取/设置表单数据</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td></td>\n<td><code>getFormData()</code> / <code>setFormData()</code></td>\n<td>获取/设置表单数据</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td></td>\n<td><code>getField()</code> / <code>getFields()</code></td>\n<td>获取单个/多个字段</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td></td>\n<td><code>setField()</code> / class=\"language-javascript\">// 在组件内通过 emitter 监听\nconst { emitter } = useFormContext();\n\n// 监听表单提交\nconst submitListener = emitter.addListener('form:submit', (args) =&gt; {\n  console.log('表单提交', args);\n});\n\n// 监听数据变化\nconst dataListener = emitter.addListener('form:set-data', ({ data }) =&gt; {\n  console.log('数据变化', data);\n});\n\n// 清理监听器\nuseEffect(() =&gt; {\n  return () =&gt; {\n    submitListener.remove();\n    dataListener.remove();\n  };\n}, []);\n</code></pre>\n<h5>生命周期钩子</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">const formApiRef = useRef();\nformApiRef.current.onReady(() =&gt; {\n  console.log('表单已就绪');\n  // 可以在这里执行初始化操作\n});\n\nformApiRef.current.onDestroy(() =&gt; {\n  console.log('表单即将销毁');\n  // 可以在这里执行清理操作\n});\n</code></pre>\n<h4>生命周期</h4>\n<h5>表单生命周期</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>阶段</th>\n<th>触发时机</th>\n<th>执行操作</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>挂载</td>\n<td>Form 配置&lt;br&gt;- 更新 interceptors 配置&lt;br&gt;- data 只更新后挂载字段的初始值，不重放已挂载字段</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>卸载</td>\n<td>Form 组件销毁</td>\n<td>- 清理所有事件监听器&lt;br&gt;- 清理异步任务&lt;br&gt;- 释放内存资源</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h5>字段生命周期</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>阶段</th>\n<th>状态</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n<th>可执行操作</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>PRE_INIT</td>\n<td>预初始化</td>\n<td>字段刚创建，尚未绑定到表单状态</td>\n<td>-</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>INIT</td>\n<td>已初始化</td>\n<td>字段已注册到表单，可以交互</td>\n<td>获取/设置值、验证、触发事件</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h5>字段状态转换流程</h5>\n<pre><code>字段创建\n  ↓\nPRE_INIT (useField 初始化)\n  ↓\nINIT (字段注册到 formState)\n  ↓\n用户交互\n  ↓\nPENDING (正在验证)\n  ↓\nPASS 或 ERROR (验证结果)\n  ↓\n用户修改或手动重置\n  ↓\nINIT (回到初始状态)\n</code></pre>\n<h5>验证状态枚举</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>状态值</th>\n<th>枚举名</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n<th>UI })</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>onRemove</td>\n<td>删除分组项</td>\n<td>function(id)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>内置验证规则</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>规则名</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n<th>格式</th>\n<th>示例</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>REQ</td>\n<td>必填验证</td>\n<td>REQ</td>\n<td>rule=\"REQ\"</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>TEL</td>\n<td>手机号验证</td>\n<td>TEL</td>\n<td>rule=\"TEL\"</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>EMAIL</td>\n<td>邮箱验证</td>\n<td>EMAIL</td>\n<td>rule=\"EMAIL\"</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>LEN</td>\n<td>长度验证</td>\n<td>LEN-{min}-{max}</td>\n<td>rule=\"LEN-3-10\"</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h5>验证规则格式说明</h5>\n<ul>\n<li>验证规则通过空格分隔，可组合多个规则</li>\n<li>LEN 规则格式：LEN-{最小长度}-{最大长度}，若最小等于最大则表示精确长度</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>全局拦截器 API</h4>\n<h5>注册拦截器</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>方法名</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>返回值</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>interceptors.input.use</td>\n<td>注册输入拦截器</td>\n<td>(name, function)</td>\n<td>number</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>interceptors.output.use</td>\n<td>注册输出拦截器</td>\n<td>(name, function)</td>\n<td>number</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h5>使用示例</h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { interceptors } from '@kne/react-form';\n\n// 注册输入拦截器（在值存入表单前执行）\ninterceptors.input.use('trim', value =&gt; value.trim());\ninterceptors.input.use('number', value =&gt; Number(value));\n\n// 注册输出拦截器（在值从表单取出时执行）\ninterceptors.output.use('formatDate', value =&gt; {\n  return value ? new Date(value).toISOString() : value;\n});\n</code></pre>\n<h4>赋值与字段重建</h4>\n<ul>\n<li><code>setField</code> / <code>setFormData</code> 会写入 pending。字段尚未注册或仍处于 PRE_INIT 时不会丢弃；挂载后按 <strong>pending &gt; data 初值 &gt; defaultValue</strong> 回填。</li>\n<li>字段卸载时（<code>preserve !== false</code>）把当前值写入 pending。React key 变化导致的重建会回填；<code>getFormData</code> 仍只汇总<strong>当前已挂载</strong>字段。</li>\n<li>FieldList 会把未 <code>filter</code> 的 list（含 <code>display={false}</code> / <code>hidden</code>）登记为声明 path。pending 里有、声明和挂载都没有的 path，对账后 forget（从 list 里 spread 掉或 GroupList 删除）。</li>\n<li>类型切换后必须清空下游时，在 <code>onChange</code> 里调用 <code>forgetField</code> / <code>setField({ name, value: undefined })</code>，不要依赖卸载推断。</li>\n<li><code>hidden</code>：仍在声明内，值保留。<code>display={false}</code>：仍在声明内，再显示能回填。从 list 删除：离开声明，forget。</li>\n<li><code>reset</code> 与 Form 卸载会清空 pending。<code>debug</code> 下 <code>setField</code> 未匹配到字段且<strong>没有</strong>写入 pending 时才会 <code>console.warn</code>。</li>\n</ul>\n<p>稳定性单测（<code>src/__tests__</code>，入口 <code>npm test</code>）：</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>createSetFieldsEvent</code>：未注册 / PRE_INIT / ready / falsy / 分组 path / debug 写入 pending 不 warn</li>\n<li><code>FormEvent</code> / <code>useOpenApi</code>：onFormDataChange 合并触发；已 mount 的 onReady 立即回调</li>\n<li><code>formFixes</code>：data 仅引用变化不重置 init</li>\n<li><code>GroupList</code>：defaultLength 不垫短数组；增删 clone 写回 init、不 splice 原数组</li>\n<li><code>Field</code>：computedFormDataFormState / stateToError 同一 Map 原地改值可读到新值</li>\n<li><code>associations</code> / <code>useFieldInit</code> / <code>createFieldChangeEvent</code>：空 fields 不匹配；fields 变化后同步</li>\n<li><code>createFieldRemoveEvent</code>：preserve 默认写入 pending、<code>preserve={false}</code>、已 forget 不再写回</li>\n<li><code>createForgetGroupEvent</code> / <code>createResetEvent</code></li>\n<li><code>fieldAssignLifecycle</code>：先 setField 后挂载、同 path 卸载再挂、声明消失、forget 后不回填</li>\n<li><code>pendingFormData</code>：对账、forgetByPrefix、mergeFormData</li>\n</ul>\n<p>&lt;!--START_SECTION:DOC_MD--&gt;</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>组件</th>\n<th>简介</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><a href=\"docs/ReactForm.md\">ReactForm</a></td>\n<td>## 核心特性 ### 📦 轻量级状态管理 - 基于 React Context + State，零额外依赖 - 支持嵌套分组和复杂数据结构 - 实时状态更新，O(1) 高效数据访问 ### 🎛️ 灵活字段控制 -…</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>&lt;!--END_SECTION:DOC_MD--&gt;</p>",

    title: "基本示例",
    description: "展示基本的表单使用方式，包括表单绑定、验证规则、提交和重置",
    code: "const { default: ReactForm, useField, useSubmit, useReset } = _ReactForm;\nconst { Input: AntInput, Button, Space, Card, Alert, Typography, message } = antd;\nconst { Text } = Typography;\n\n// ========================================\n// 通用组件\n// ========================================\n\nconst Input = props => {\n  const fieldProps = useField(props);\n  const isError = fieldProps.errState === 2;\n  const isValidating = fieldProps.errState === 3;\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n      <div style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>\n        <Text type={isError ? 'danger' : undefined}>{fieldProps.label}</Text>\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <AntInput\n          ref={fieldProps.fieldRef}\n          type={props.type || 'text'}\n          value={fieldProps.value || ''}\n          onChange={e => {\n            fieldProps.onChange(e.target.value);\n            fieldProps.triggerValidate();\n          }}\n          onBlur={fieldProps.triggerValidate}\n          placeholder={props.placeholder}\n          status={isError ? 'error' : undefined}\n          style={{ width: props.width || 200 }}\n        />\n        {fieldProps.errMsg && (\n          <Text type=\"danger\" style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>\n            {fieldProps.errMsg}\n          </Text>\n        )}\n        {isValidating && (\n          <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>\n            验证中...\n          </Text>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nconst SubmitButton = ({ children, isPassButton = false }) => {\n  const { isLoading, isPass, onClick } = useSubmit();\n  return (\n    <Button\n      type=\"primary\"\n      onClick={onClick}\n      disabled={isPassButton ? (isLoading || !isPass) : isLoading}\n      loading={isLoading}\n    >\n      {children}\n    </Button>\n  );\n};\n\nconst ResetButton = () => {\n  const { onClick } = useReset();\n  return <Button onClick={onClick}>重置</Button>;\n};\n\n// ========================================\n// 基本表单示例\n// ========================================\n\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n  return (\n    <Card title=\"基本表单示例\" style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>\n      <ReactForm\n        debug\n        data={{ name: '哈哈哈' }}\n        onSubmit={async data => {\n          await new Promise(resolve => {\n            setTimeout(() => {\n              resolve();\n            }, 3000);\n          });\n          console.log('submit:', data);\n          message.success('提交成功: ' + JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));\n        }}\n      >\n        <Input name=\"name\" label=\"名称\" rule=\"REQ LEN-0-10\" />\n        <Input name=\"email\" label=\"邮箱\" rule=\"REQ EMAIL\" />\n        <Input name=\"phone\" label=\"手机号\" rule=\"REQ TEL\" />\n        <Space>\n          <SubmitButton>提交</SubmitButton>\n          <ResetButton />\n        </Space>\n      </ReactForm>\n    </Card>\n  );\n};\n\n// ========================================\n// isPass 测试示例\n// ========================================\n\nconst IsPassStatusDisplay = () => {\n  const { isPass } = useSubmit();\n  return (\n    <Alert\n      message={`表单验证状态：${isPass ? '全部通过' : '存在错误'}`}\n      description={isPass ? '所有字段验证通过，可以提交' : '请检查并修正错误信息'}\n      type={isPass ? 'success' : 'error'}\n      showIcon\n      style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}\n    />\n  );\n};\n\nconst IsPassExample = () => {\n  return (\n    <Card title=\"isPass 测试示例\" extra={\n      <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>\n        所有字段在输入停止后（失焦）触发校验\n      </Text>\n    }>\n      <ReactForm\n        debug\n        data={{\n          username: '',\n          email: '',\n          password: '',\n          confirmPassword: '',\n          age: ''\n        }}\n        onSubmit={async data => {\n          await new Promise(resolve => {\n            setTimeout(() => {\n              resolve();\n            }, 1000);\n          });\n          console.log('submit:', data);\n          message.success('提交成功: ' + JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));\n        }}\n      >\n        <IsPassStatusDisplay />\n\n        <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n          <Text strong>基本信息</Text>\n        </div>\n        <Input\n          name=\"username\"\n          label=\"用户名\"\n          rule=\"REQ LEN-3-20\"\n          placeholder=\"请输入用户名（3-20字符）\"\n          width={250}\n        />\n        <Input\n          name=\"email\"\n          label=\"邮箱\"\n          rule=\"REQ EMAIL\"\n          placeholder=\"请输入邮箱地址\"\n          width={250}\n        />\n        <Input\n          name=\"age\"\n          label=\"年龄\"\n          rule=\"REQ LEN-1-3\"\n          placeholder=\"请输入年龄（1-3位数字）\"\n          width={250}\n        />\n\n        <div style={{ marginBottom: 16, marginTop: 16 }}>\n          <Text strong>安全信息</Text>\n        </div>\n        <Input\n          name=\"password\"\n          label=\"密码\"\n          rule=\"REQ LEN-6-20\"\n          placeholder=\"请输入密码（6-20字符）\"\n          type=\"password\"\n          width={250}\n        />\n        <Input\n          name=\"confirmPassword\"\n          label=\"确认密码\"\n          rule=\"REQ LEN-6-20\"\n          placeholder=\"请再次输入密码\"\n          type=\"password\"\n          width={250}\n        />\n\n        <SubmitButton isPassButton>提交注册</SubmitButton>\n      </ReactForm>\n    </Card>\n  );\n};\n\n// ========================================\n// 主组件\n// ========================================\n\nconst App = () => {\n  return (\n    <div style={{ padding: 24, background: '#f5f5f5', minHeight: '100vh' }}>\n      <Space direction=\"vertical\" style={{ width: '100%' }} size=\"large\">\n        <BaseExample />\n        <IsPassExample />\n      </Space>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<App />);\n\n",

    title: "defaultValue 初值",
    description: "通过 defaultValue 为表单字段设置初始值，FormInner 组件内部使用 useFormApi 访问表单 API",
    code: "const { default: ReactForm, useField, useSubmit, useReset, useFormApi } = _ReactForm;\nconst { useRef } = React;\nconst { Button, Space, Card, Input: AntInput, Typography, message, Divider, Descriptions, Select, Row, Col } = antd;\nconst { Text } = Typography;\n\n// ========================================\n// 通用输入组件\n// ========================================\n\nconst Input = props => {\n  const fieldProps = useField(props);\n  const isError = fieldProps.errState === 2;\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n      <div style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>\n        <Text type={isError ? 'danger' : undefined}>{fieldProps.label}</Text>\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <AntInput\n          ref={fieldProps.fieldRef}\n          type=\"text\"\n          value={fieldProps.value || ''}\n          onChange={e => fieldProps.onChange(e.target.value)}\n          onBlur={fieldProps.triggerValidate}\n          placeholder={props.placeholder}\n          status={isError ? 'error' : undefined}\n          style={{ width: 200 }}\n        />\n        {fieldProps.errMsg && (\n          <Text type=\"danger\" style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>\n            {fieldProps.errMsg}\n          </Text>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\n// ========================================\n// Object 类型字段组件 (defaultValue 为对象)\n// ========================================\n\nconst AddressField = props => {\n  const fieldProps = useField(props);\n  const isError = fieldProps.errState === 2;\n  const value = fieldProps.value || {};\n\n  const handleChange = (key, newValue) => {\n    fieldProps.onChange({\n      ...value,\n      [key]: newValue\n    });\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n      <div style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>\n        <Text type={isError ? 'danger' : undefined}>{fieldProps.label}</Text>\n      </div>\n      <Row gutter={8}>\n        <Col>\n          <Select\n            value={value.province || undefined}\n            onChange={v => handleChange('province', v)}\n            placeholder=\"省份\"\n            style={{ width: 120 }}\n            options={[\n              { value: '北京市', label: '北京市' },\n              { value: '上海市', label: '上海市' },\n              { value: '广东省', label: '广东省' },\n              { value: '浙江省', label: '浙江省' }\n            ]}\n          />\n        </Col>\n        <Col>\n          <Select\n            value={value.city || undefined}\n            onChange={v => handleChange('city', v)}\n            placeholder=\"城市\"\n            style={{ width: 120 }}\n            options={[\n              { value: '朝阳区', label: '朝阳区' },\n              { value: '海淀区', label: '海淀区' },\n              { value: '浦东新区', label: '浦东新区' },\n              { value: '天河区', label: '天河区' }\n            ]}\n          />\n        </Col>\n        <Col>\n          <AntInput value={value.detail || ''} onChange={e => handleChange('detail', e.target.value)} placeholder=\"详细地址\" style={{ width: 200 }} />\n        </Col>\n      </Row>\n      {fieldProps.errMsg && (\n        <Text type=\"danger\" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>\n          {fieldProps.errMsg}\n        </Text>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nconst TimeRangeField = props => {\n  const fieldProps = useField(props);\n  const isError = fieldProps.errState === 2;\n  const value = fieldProps.value || { start: '', end: '' };\n\n  const handleChange = (key, newValue) => {\n    fieldProps.onChange({\n      ...value,\n      [key]: newValue\n    });\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n      <div style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>\n        <Text type={isError ? 'danger' : undefined}>{fieldProps.label}</Text>\n      </div>\n      <Space>\n        <AntInput type=\"time\" value={value.start || ''} onChange={e => handleChange('start', e.target.value)} placeholder=\"开始时间\" style={{ width: 150 }} />\n        <Text>至</Text>\n        <AntInput type=\"time\" value={value.end || ''} onChange={e => handleChange('end', e.target.value)} placeholder=\"结束时间\" style={{ width: 150 }} />\n      </Space>\n      {fieldProps.errMsg && (\n        <div>\n          <Text type=\"danger\" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>\n            {fieldProps.errMsg}\n          </Text>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nconst SubmitButton = ({ children }) => {\n  const { isLoading, onClick } = useSubmit();\n  return (\n    <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={onClick} loading={isLoading} style={{ marginRight: 8 }}>\n      {children}\n    </Button>\n  );\n};\n\nconst ResetButton = () => {\n  const { onClick } = useReset();\n  return <Button onClick={onClick}>重置</Button>;\n};\n\n// ========================================\n// FormInner 组件：在内部使用 useFormApi\n// ========================================\n\nconst FormInner = () => {\n  const { openApi: formApi } = useFormApi();\n  const formData = formApi.getFormData();\n\n  return (\n    <Card type=\"inner\" title=\"FormInner 组件 (使用 useFormApi)\" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n      <Descriptions column={1} size=\"small\" bordered>\n        <Descriptions.Item label=\"当前表单数据\">\n          <Text code>{JSON.stringify(formData)}</Text>\n        </Descriptions.Item>\n        <Descriptions.Item label=\"操作\">\n          <Space wrap>\n            <Button\n              size=\"small\"\n              onClick={() => {\n                const name = formData.name || '默认姓名';\n                formApi.setField({ name: 'name', value: name + '_modified' });\n                message.success('已修改 name 字段');\n              }}>\n              修改姓名\n            </Button>\n            <Button\n              size=\"small\"\n              onClick={() => {\n                formApi.setFields([\n                  { name: 'email', value: 'default@example.com' },\n                  { name: 'phone', value: '13800138000' }\n                ]);\n                message.success('已批量设置字段');\n              }}>\n              批量设置\n            </Button>\n            <Button\n              size=\"small\"\n              onClick={() => {\n                formApi.reset();\n                message.info('表单已重置');\n              }}>\n              重置表单\n            </Button>\n          </Space>\n        </Descriptions.Item>\n      </Descriptions>\n    </Card>\n  );\n};\n\n// ========================================\n// 主示例\n// ========================================\n\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n  return (\n    <div style={{ padding: 24, background: '#f5f5f5', minHeight: '100vh' }}>\n      <Card title=\"defaultValue 初值示例\">\n        <Space direction=\"vertical\" style={{ width: '100%' }}>\n          <Text type=\"secondary\">通过 defaultValue 为表单字段设置初始值，支持基础类型和对象类型</Text>\n\n          <ReactForm\n            debug\n            onSubmit={async data => {\n              await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));\n              console.log('submit:', data);\n              message.success('提交成功');\n            }}>\n            <FormInner />\n\n            <Divider>基础类型 defaultValue</Divider>\n\n            <Input name=\"name\" label=\"姓名\" rule=\"REQ LEN-0-10\" defaultValue=\"张三\" placeholder=\"请输入姓名\" />\n            <Input name=\"email\" label=\"邮箱\" rule=\"REQ EMAIL\" defaultValue=\"zhangsan@example.com\" placeholder=\"请输入邮箱\" />\n            <Input name=\"phone\" label=\"手机号\" rule=\"REQ TEL\" defaultValue=\"13900139000\" placeholder=\"请输入手机号\" />\n\n            <Divider>Object 类型 defaultValue</Divider>\n\n            <AddressField\n              name=\"address\"\n              label=\"地址\"\n              rule=\"REQ\"\n              defaultValue={{\n                province: '北京市',\n                city: '朝阳区',\n                detail: '望京街道'\n              }}\n            />\n            <TimeRangeField\n              name=\"workTime\"\n              label=\"工作时间\"\n              defaultValue={{\n                start: '09:00',\n                end: '18:00'\n              }}\n            />\n\n            <Divider />\n\n            <Space>\n              <SubmitButton>提交</SubmitButton>\n              <ResetButton />\n            </Space>\n          </ReactForm>\n        </Space>\n      </Card>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample />);\n\n",

(\n        <pre style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: 11, maxHeight: 240, overflow: 'auto', background: '#fafafa', padding: 8 }}>\n          {JSON.stringify(snap, null, 2)}\n        </pre>\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nconst Toolbar = () => {\n  const { openApi } = useFormApi();\n  return (\n    <Space wrap style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n      <Button\n        type=\"primary\"\n        onClick={() => {\n          console.log('[nested-set-form-data] setFormData once', SAMPLE_DATA);\n          openApi.setFormData(SAMPLE_DATA, false);\n        }}>\n        一次 setFormData（模拟 AI 填充）\n      </Button>\n      <Button\n        onClick={() => {\n          openApi.setFormData({ skill: [{ name: '', contentItems: [] }] }, false);\n        }}>\n        重置为 1 条空技能\n      </Button>\n     code: "const { default: ReactForm, useField, useSubmit, useReset, useFormApi } = _ReactForm;\nconst { useEffect, useState } = React;\nconst { Button, Space, Card, Input: AntInput, Select: AntSelect, Radio, Switch, Tag, Typography, message } = antd;\nconst { Text } = Typography;\n\nconst Input = props => {\n  const fieldProps = useField(props);\n  const isError = fieldProps.errState === 2;\n  const isValidating = fieldProps.errState === 3;\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n      <div style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>\n        <Text type={isError ? );\n};\n\nconst DefaultLengthCard = () => {\n  const formRef = useRef(null);\n  const listRef = useRef(null);\n  return (\n    <Card\n      type=\"inner\"\n      title={\n        <Space>\n          5. );\n};\n\nconst AssociationsCard = () => {\n  const [source, setSource] = useState('name');\n  return (\n    <Card\n      type=\"inner\"\n      title={\n        <Space>\n          9. 动态     title: "远程验证规则",
    description: "自定义远程异步验证规则，模拟接口调用进行字段校验",
    code: "const { default: ReactForm, useField, useSubmit, useReset } = _ReactForm;\nconst { useState, useEffect } = React;\nconst { Button, Space, Card, Input: AntInput, Typography, Alert, message, List, Tag, Divider, Descriptions } = antd;\nconst { Text } = Typography;\n\nconst Input = props => {\n  const fieldProps = useField(props);\n  const isError = fieldProps.errState === 2;\n  const isValidating = fieldProps.errState === 3;\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n      <div style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>\n        <Text type={isError ? 'danger' : undefined}>{fieldProps.label}</Text>\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <AntInput ref={fieldProps.fieldRef} type=\"text\" value={fieldProps.value || ''} onChange={e => fieldProps.onChange(e.target.value)} onBlur={fieldProps.triggerValidate} status={isError ? 'error' : undefined} style={{ width: 200 }} />\n        {fieldProps.errMsg && (\n          <Text type=\"danger\" style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>\n            {fieldProps.errMsg}\n          </Text>\n        )}\n        {isValidating && (\n          <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>\n            验证中...\n          </Text>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nconst SubmitButton = ({ children }) => {\n  const { isLoading, onClick } = useSubmit();\n  return (\n    <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={onClick} loading={isLoading} style={{ marginRight: 8 }}>\n      {children}\n    </Button>\n  );\n};\n\nconst ResetButton = () => {\n  const { onClick } = useReset();\n  return <Button onClick={onClick}>重置</Button>;\n};\n\n// 校验日志组件\nconst ValidationLog = () => {\n  const [logs, setLogs] = useState([]);\n  const listRef = React.useRef(null);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    // 拦截 console.log 来捕获验证日志\n    const originalLog = console.log;\n    console.log = (...args) => {\n      const message = args.join(' ');\n      if (message.includes('验证')) {\n        const timestamp = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();\n        setLogs(prev => [...prev, { id: Date.now() + Math.random(), timestamp, message }]);\n      }\n      originalLog.apply(console, args);\n    };\n    return () => {\n      console.log = originalLog;\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  // 自动滚动到底部\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (listRef.current) {\n      listRef.current.scrollTop = listRef.current.scrollHeight;\n    }\n  }, [logs]);\n\n  const clearLogs = () => setLogs([]);\n\n  return (\n    <Card title=\"远程校验过程\" size=\"small\" style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>\n      <Space style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>\n        <Button size=\"small\" onClick={clearLogs}>清空日志</Button>\n        <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>共 {logs.length} 条记录</Text>\n      </Space>\n      <div ref={listRef} style={{ height: 300, overflowY: 'auto', border: '1px solid #f0f0f0', borderRadius: 4 }}>\n        {logs.length === 0 ? (\n          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', height: '100%' }}>\n            <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>\n              暂无验证日志，请在上方输入框中输入内容触发验证\n            </Text>\n          </div>\n        ) : (\n          <List\n            size=\"small\"\n            dataSource={logs}\n            renderItem={item => {\n              const isStart = item.message.includes('开始验证');\n              const isComplete = item.message.includes('验证完成');\n              return (\n                <List.Item style={{ padding: '8px 12', borderBottom: '1px solid #f0f0f0' }}>\n                  <Space>\n                    <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 11, minWidth: 70 }}>{item.timestamp}</Text>\n                    <Tag color={isStart ? 'blue' : isComplete ? 'green' : 'default'} style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n                      {isStart ? '开始' : isComplete ? '完成' : '其他'}\n                    </Tag>\n                    <Text style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{item.message}</Text>\n                  </Space>\n                </List.Item>\n              );\n            }}\n          />\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </Card>\n  );\n};\n\n// 模拟用户名重复检查的远程验证规则\nconst checkUsernameUnique = async value => {\n  if (!value) {\n    return { result: false, errMsg: '用户名不能为空' };\n  }\n\n  // 模拟已存在的用户名\n  const existingUsernames = ['admin', 'test', 'user', 'root'];\n\n  console.log(`开始验证用户名: ${value}`);\n  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));\n  console.log(`验证完成用户名: ${value}`);\n\n  if (existingUsernames.includes(value)) {\n    return { result: false, errMsg: '该用户名已被占用' };\n  }\n\n  return { result: true, errMsg: '' };\n};\n\n// 模拟手机号有效性检查的远程验证规则\nconst checkPhoneValid = async value => {\n  if (!value) {\n    return { result: false, errMsg: '手机号不能为空' };\n  }\n\n  console.log(`开始验证手机号: ${value}`);\n  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));\n  console.log(`验证完成手机号: ${value}`);\n\n  // 模拟手机号黑名单\n  const blackList = ['13800138000', '13900139000'];\n\n  if (blackList.includes(value)) {\n    return { result: false, errMsg: '该手机号已被注册' };\n  }\n\n  return { result: true, errMsg: '' };\n};\n\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n  return (\n    <div style={{ padding: 24, background: '#f5f5f5', minHeight: '100vh' }}>\n      <Card title=\"远程验证规则示例\" bordered={false}>\n        <Alert message=\"异步验证说明\" description=\"示例展示了如何使用自定义的异步验证规则来模拟远程接口验证\" type=\"info\" showIcon style={{ marginBottom: 20 }} />\n\n        <ValidationLog />\n\n        <Card type=\"inner\" title=\"特殊输入值说明\" size=\"small\" style={{ marginBottom: 20, backgroundColor: '#fff7e6' }}>\n          <Descriptions column={1} size=\"small\">\n            <Descriptions.Item label=\"已占用用户名\">\n              <Space>\n                <Tag color=\"red\">admin</Tag>\n                <Tag color=\"red\">test</Tag>\n                <Tag color=\"red\">user</Tag>\n                <Tag color=\"red\">root</Tag>\n              </Space>\n            </Descriptions.Item>\n            <Descriptions.Item label=\"已注册手机号\">\n              <Space>\n                <Tag color=\"red\">13800138000</Tag>\n                <Tag color=\"red\">13900139000</Tag>\n              </Space>\n            </Descriptions.Item>\n          </Descriptions>\n          <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>\n            💡 输入以上值会触发验证失败，用于测试错误提示和校验过程\n          </Text>\n        </Card>\n\n        <ReactForm\n          debug\n          rules={{\n            CHECK_USERNAME: checkUsernameUnique,\n            CHECK_PHONE: checkPhoneValid\n          }}\n          data={{\n            username: '',\n            phone: ''\n          }}\n          onSubmit={async data => {\n            console.log('提交数据:', data);\n            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));\n            message.success('注册成功: ' + JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));\n          }}>\n          <Input name=\"username\" label=\"用户名\" rule=\"REQ LEN-3-20 CHECK_USERNAME\" placeholder=\"请输入用户名\" />\n          <Input name=\"phone\" label=\"手机号\" rule=\"REQ TEL CHECK_PHONE\" placeholder=\"请输入手机号\" />\n\n          <div style={{ marginTop: 20 }}>\n            <Space>\n              <SubmitButton>注册</SubmitButton>\n              <ResetButton />\n            </Space>\n          </div>\n        </ReactForm>\n      </Card>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample />);\n\n",

    code: "const { default: ReactForm, useField, useSubmit, useReset, useFormApi } = _ReactForm;\nconst { useRef } = React;\nconst { Button, Space, Card, Input: AntInput, InputNumber, Select, Switch, Typography, message, Divider, Descriptions, Alert } = antd;\nconst { Text } = Typography;\n\n// ========================================\n// 通用组件\n// ========================================\n\nconst Input = props => {\n  const fieldProps = useField(props);\n  const isError = fieldProps.errState === 2;\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n      <div style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>\n        <Text type={isError ? 'danger' : undefined}>{fieldProps.label}</Text>\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <AntInput\n          ref={fieldProps.fieldRef}\n          type={props.type || 'text'}\n          value={fieldProps.value ?? ''}\n          onChange={e => {\n            fieldProps.onChange(e.target.value);\n            fieldProps.triggerValidate();\n          }}\n          onBlur={fieldProps.triggerValidate}\n          placeholder={props.placeholder}\n          status={isError ? 'danger' : undefined}>{fieldProps.label}</Text>\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <InputNumber\n          ref={fieldProps.fieldRef}\n          value={fieldProps.value}\n          onChange={val => {\n            fieldProps.onChange(val);\n            fieldProps.triggerValidate();\n          }}\n          placeholder={props.placeholder}\n          status={isError ? 'error' : undefined}\n          style={{ width: props.width || 200 }}\n          min={props.min}\n          max={props.max}\n        />\n        {fieldProps.errMsg && (\n          <Text type=\"danger\" style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>\n            {fieldProps.errMsg}\n          </Text>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nconst SelectField = props => {\n  const fieldProps = useField(props);\n  const isError = fieldProps.errState === 2;\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n      <div style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>\n        <Text type={isError ? 'error' : undefined}\n          style={{ width: props.width || 200 }}\n          options={props.options}\n        />\n        {fieldProps.errMsg && (\n          <Text type=\"danger\" style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>\n            {fieldProps.errMsg}\n          </Text>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nconst SwitchField = props => {\n  const fieldProps = useField(props);\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n      <div style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>\n        <Text>{fieldProps.label}</Text>\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <Switch\n          ref={fieldProps.fieldRef}\n          checked={!!fieldProps.value}\n          onChange={val => {\n            fieldProps.onChange(val);\n          }}\n        />\n        <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>\n          当前值: {String(fieldProps.value)}\n        </Text>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nconst SubmitButton = ({ children }) => {\n  const { isLoading, onClick } = useSubmit();\n  return (\n    <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={onClick} loading={isLoading}>\n      {children}\n    </Button>\n  );\n};\n\nconst ResetButton = () => {\n  const { onClick } = useReset();\n  return <Button onClick={onClick} style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>重置</Button>;\n};\n\n// ========================================\n// FormInner 组件：展示表单当前数据\n// title=\"当前表单数据\" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n      <Descriptions column={1} size=\"small\" bordered>\n        <Descriptions.Item label=\"表单数据\">\n          <Text code>{JSON.stringify(formData)}</Text>\n        </Descriptions.Item>\n      </Descriptions>\n    </Card>\n  );\n};\n\n// ========================================\n// 示例：data 中包含数字 0 的表单\n// }}>\n        验证 data 中字段值为 0 时能正确显示\n      </Text>\n    }>\n      <Space direction=\"vertical\" style={{ width: '100%' }}>\n        <Alert\n          message=\"说明\"\n          description='当 Form 的 data 属性中字段值为 0 或 false 等 falsy 值时，表单需要正确识别并赋值，而非将其视为空值。'\n          type=\"info\"\n          showIcon\n          style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}\n        />\n\n        <ReactForm\n          debug\n          data={{\n            name: '测试项目',\n            count: 0,\n            score: 0,\n            level: 0,\n            enabled: 0,\n            isActive: false,\n            isPublic: false,\n            description: ''\n          }}\n          onSubmit={async data => {\n            await new Promise(resolve => {\n              setTimeout(() => resolve(), 1000);\n            });\n            console.log('submit:', data);\n            message.success('提交成功: ' + JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));\n          }}\n        >\n          <FormInner />\n\n          <Divider>值为 0 的字段</Divider>\n\n      <Divider>值为 false 的字段</Divider>\n\n          <SwitchField name=\"isActive\" label=\"是否激活 (data=false)\" />\n\n          <SwitchField name=\"isPublic\" label=\"是否公开 (data=false)\" />\n\n          <Input name=\"description\" label=\"描述 (data='')\" placeholder=\"请输入描述\" />\n\n          <Divider />\n\n          <Space>\n            <SubmitButton>提交</SubmitButton>\n            <ResetButton />\n
